import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import statistics
import subprocess
import sys

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "scripts"))
import stability

def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()

servers = {"control": ROOT / "artifacts/baselines/e2d7cf9/war-relay",
           "selected": ROOT / "artifacts/baselines/b066540/war-relay"}
inspection = ROOT / "artifacts/baselines/e2d7cf9/inspection"
stress = ROOT / "artifacts/baselines/e2d7cf9/stress"
output = ROOT / "docs/benchmarks/2026-10-16-reactor-mixed.json"
record = {"scope": "Sequential fresh four-worker servers, frozen identical clients, server CPUs 0-3 and clients 4-7. Mixed cases hold 8192 idle rooms and two private pairs with eight reconnect workers. Management adds two authenticated HTTP inspectors at 100 requests/s each. Large uses 32 verified private self-message clients, 64KiB values and window 16. Setup/teardown included only where stated in underlying trace. Medians are from three repetitions; ordering reverses. No profiler, concurrent builds or other load tests.",
          "source_revision": subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], cwd=ROOT, text=True).strip(),
          "driver_source": Path(__file__).read_text(), "driver_sha256": sha(__file__),
          "binaries": {k: {"path": str(v), "sha256": sha(v)} for k,v in servers.items()},
          "clients": {"inspection": sha(inspection), "stress": sha(stress)},
          "helper_sha256": {name: sha(ROOT / "scripts" / name) for name in ["inspection.py", "benchmark.py", "stability.py"]},
          "cases": [], "passed": False}
if output.exists():
    previous = json.loads(output.read_text())
    assert previous['binaries'] == record['binaries']
    assert previous['clients'] == record['clients']
    assert previous['helper_sha256'] == record['helper_sha256']
    revisions = previous.get('driver_revisions', [{'sha256': previous['driver_sha256'], 'source': previous['driver_source']}])
    revisions.append({'sha256': record['driver_sha256'], 'source': record['driver_source'], 'note': 'Corrected extraction of stability result fields; reused already verified traces; workload unchanged.'})
    record['driver_revisions'] = revisions
    record['cases'] = previous['cases']
for repetition in range(1, 4):
    kinds = ["control", "selected"] if repetition % 2 else ["selected", "control"]
    names = ["churn", "management", "large"]
    offset = (repetition - 1) % len(names)
    for name in names[offset:] + names[:offset]:
        for kind in kinds:
            if any(r['kind'] == kind and r['workload'] == name and r['repetition'] == repetition for r in record['cases']):
                continue
            trace = output.with_name(f"{output.stem}-{name}-{kind}-{repetition}.json")
            if trace.exists() and json.loads(trace.read_text()).get('passed'):
                data = json.loads(trace.read_text())
                assert str(servers[kind]) in data['server_command']
            elif name == "large":
                data = stability.run_case("traffic", 4, 32, server_binary=servers[kind], stress_binary=stress,
                                          payload_bytes=65536, server_cpus="0-3", client_cpus="4-7")
                trace.write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=2) + "\n")
            else:
                command = [sys.executable, str(ROOT/"scripts/inspection.py"), "--server", str(servers[kind]),
                           "--client", str(inspection), "--seconds", "8", "--churn-workers", "8",
                           "--mode", "http" if name == "management" else "none",
                           "--read-storage", "connection" if kind == "control" else "worker", "--output", str(trace)]
                done = subprocess.run(command, cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, text=True)
                if done.returncode:
                    raise RuntimeError(done.stdout + done.stderr)
                data = json.loads(trace.read_text())
            assert data["passed"], data
            row = {"kind": kind, "workload": name, "repetition": repetition,
                   "trace": str(trace.relative_to(ROOT)), "trace_sha256": sha(trace), "passed": True}
            if name == "large":
                measured = next(item for item in data['output'] if item.get('event') == 'result')
                row.update(healthy=measured["deliveries_per_second"], p99_ms=measured["latency_p99_upper_ms"],
                           rss_peak_mib=max([data['baseline']['process']['VmRSS']] + [s['process']['VmRSS'] for s in data['samples']])/1024,
                           cpu_seconds_per_wall_second=(data['final']['process']['cpu_seconds'] - data['baseline']['process']['cpu_seconds'])/measured["elapsed_seconds"])
            else:
                measured = data["mixed"]
                row.update(healthy=measured["healthy"]["per_second"], p99_ms=measured["healthy"]["p99_upper_ms"],
                           churn=measured["churn"]["per_second"], inspection=measured["inspection"]["per_second"],
                           inspection_p99_ms=measured["inspection"]["p99_upper_ms"],
                           rss_measured_mib=data["events"][1]["process"]["VmRSS"]/1024,
                           cpu_seconds_per_wall_second=measured["server_cpu_seconds_per_wall_second"])
            record["cases"].append(row)
            output.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + "\n")
            print(json.dumps(row), flush=True)
record["medians"] = {}
for name in ["churn", "management", "large"]:
    for kind in servers:
        rows = [r for r in record["cases"] if r["kind"] == kind and r["workload"] == name]
        keys = [k for k in rows[0] if isinstance(rows[0][k], (float, int)) and k not in ["repetition", "passed"]]
        record["medians"][f"{name}/{kind}"] = {k: statistics.median(r[k] for r in rows) for k in keys}
record["passed"] = True
output.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + "\n")
print(json.dumps({"passed": True, "medians": record["medians"]}), flush=True)
